label: Late in the episode, S1-favouring belief and choosing a1 pull z down, most at D2.
terms: belief_lo * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (ep_trial >= 95) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 2) * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (prev_action == 1) * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (ep_trial >= 90) * ((tv("action",-1)==1) + (tv("action",-2)==1)) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * ep_trial
explanation: Update gate unit 14 sits near 1 (mean 0.994) and drops in the last ~10 trials of the episode, most at D2; timing covers that drop. Beyond timing, the drop is deeper when the observer belief favours S1 (belief_lo > 0) late in the episode, and at D2 when the trial just chose a1 (observed at D2), getting stronger toward trial 99. Rare a1->S2 trials and runs of a1 choices make it deeper still (free-fit terms: action x state, prev_action, a1 counts over the last 2 trials). Earlier in the episode the same pattern exists but is small (D2 residual follows belief deciles, about +0.008 to -0.013). This trial reward and the next choice add little. The short form only uses observed quantities (belief_lo, and the current choice only at D2, where it is known). The free fit adds history and transition terms on top.
